reviews.title: Changes
reviews.text: I don’t really like what the app has done. The rewards signing in is fine and I actually really like that incentive! BUT the in app purchases ?? You buy things on an app about logging moods? It’s ridiculous. I’ve been loyal to this app since 2019, and they take things to give to premium members. WHICH premium members would have to pay 4.99 MONTHLY or 40 annually? Why? Why add in app purchases to a diary app. It’s plainly dumb. All people without or with money should have the same things.  I’m overall really disappointed in these changes. I even had premium once before because I installed EMMO when it just had been getting traction but it was suddenly revoked!

reviews.title: super cute! would love to see additional features implemented though
reviews.text:
i’ve loved this app ever since i started using it in 2021, but i would love to see some more features and customization options added, if possible!

1. it would be really nice if we could upload our own photos to use for the daily mood emoticons! the advanced artboard is great, but i would love an option to upload artwork that i’ve made outside of the app too. 
2. i’ve seen it mentioned before, but a search function would be a great way to look at all related entries over time! i also just like to go back and read old entries in the app sometimes, so a search function would make it a lot easier to find them without having to scroll and skim through them all. 
3. it would also be really nice if the upload limit for videos and photos were increased. the length of videos is also limited to 30 seconds, which i find a bit restricting, so i would love to see that increased as well. 
4. it’s really nice that we can use emojis when typing our entries, but as an apple user, i would love to be able to use the custom stickers that i’d saved to my keyboard too. 

overall though, i really love this app and its concept! it’s user-friendly and easy to access, though you might have to google translate some settings occasionally. as someone who loves keeping a diary but finds it difficult/time-consuming to write in a physical one every day, this app is great! it would just be perfect if some more customization options were added :3

reviews.title: Features missing and feedback!
reviews.text: This app is so stinking cute. However, it’s hard to figure out how to put other peoples mood reactions in your own tracker. In addition, it should have the month hovering over for the overview instead of just saying 2026, 07. We also need different fonts! Then, this app would be perfect. It would also be a nice addition to add an actual calendar to look back on instead of the circles being everywhere with a giant blank space on the iPad. It would be nice to have both! It would also be nice to be able to decorate the blank space with furniture or decorates to make it look like a pomodoro timer. It would also be nice to have more Emoticon mood packs like Dailybean. This is such a cute app concept.
